assertions.assertion: Program.cs uses different connection strings for configuration store and operational store
assertions.rationale: Configuration store uses GetConnectionString("ConfigDb") and operational store uses GetConnectionString("OpsDb").

assertions.assertion: Program.cs sets DefaultSchema = 'config' or similar on the configuration store options
assertions.rationale: options.DefaultSchema = "config" is set on the configuration store.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs sets DefaultSchema = 'ops' or similar on the operational store options
assertions.rationale: options.DefaultSchema = "ops" is set on the operational store.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls MigrationsHistoryTable for at least one of the stores with a custom table name and schema
assertions.rationale: Both stores call MigrationsHistoryTable with custom names (__ConfigMigrationsHistory/config and __OpsMigrationsHistory/ops).

assertions.assertion: appsettings.json contains both ConfigDb and OpsDb connection strings under ConnectionStrings
assertions.rationale: The appsettings.json snippet defines both ConfigDb and OpsDb under ConnectionStrings.
